title: Lo rondallayre: quentos populars catalans, tercera série (Francesc Maspons i Labrós, 1875), full text, Catalan Wikisource revision 178765 (raw wikitext)
period: 19th-century Catalan (1875), pre-normative spelling (y for i, á accents); not medieval
notes: Author Francesc de Sales Maspons i Labrós, 1840-1901 (Viquipèdia), so the 1875 text is in the public domain; Wikisource serves it under its site terms (CC BY-SA 4.0, stated in the ca.wikisource page footer), and the page says the text was digitized by the Institut d'Estudis Catalans for the CTILC. The url pins a fixed revision (oldid 178765) served as raw wikitext, so the bytes do not change with later edits; fetched twice with the same sha256. 206,046 bytes; vs/refcorpus.normalize(..., 'catalan') gives 198,753 characters (wikitext headings and a few markup words such as 'big' and 'code' remain, well under 0.1%). Folk tales, not herbal or medical writing, and 19th rather than 15th century: it gives Catalan measured power on the grid now, and a medieval Catalan text (Llull, Eiximenis, Desclot) should replace it when one is found in a single open file. Large single-page medieval Catalan texts on ca.wikisource are split by chapter; Project Gutenberg was down for maintenance during this search.
